answer: Joining costs a real stake: each identity must lock a registration bond that vests only after months of honest participation. A bot farm multiplying accounts hits a glacier of upfront capital - a thousand identities cost a thousand bonds, all exposed to slashing if any of them copies or floods. The bond sits at the edge like a jetty, separating open water from the harbor of counted voices; the barrier is simple, and every terrace of standing above it is earned slowly, never minted in bulk.
